Centre Denies Censor Exemption for 31 Films at Kerala Festival

The Union government has rejected allegations from Kerala that 31 films were denied screening at the Docu & Short Film Festival. The Centre stated it denied censor exemption for these films, leading to uncertainty about their screening at the festival.
